Indian stock markets close higher amid global trends

Indian stock markets, including the BSE and Nifty, recovered early losses to trade higher by the end of the trading period. This recovery occurred amidst global market trends where US indices saw gains, partly driven by AI stocks. Factors influencing the Indian market included foreign inflows and softer crude prices, though IT stock sell-offs and monsoon concerns presented headwinds.
